incident-bot: PagerDuty -> Triggered: service-router:ephemeral-503-spike (PD#7890) paging @alex-oncall :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Alert details:
- symptom: 503 spikes on router-prod-us-east-1
- trigger: error-rate > 4% for 30s
- severity: P3 (auto-acked allowed)
- link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD7890

alex: acked :white_check_mark:
Alex: seeing the page, joining. Anyone on-call with extra context?

sam: i'm watching metrics now — loading grafana panel: /d/router/latency?org=1&view=us-east-1 :eyes:
sam: short spike to ~6% 503s around 1749994305-1749994335 then falls back. throughput steady.

alex: any customer reports?

sam: quick slack search — one merchant reported a checkout error 1749994318 (DM thread), not yet confirmed system-wide. Synthetic canary shows 4.8% error over 30s in us-east-1 then auto-resolved.

alex: running quick tail of envoy logs on router-prod-us-east-1:
```
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/router-prod -c envoy --since=1m | grep 503 | tail -n 50
# shows a burst of backend 502->503 from a single backend pool IP
```

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty -> Incident PD7890 automatically transitioned to RESOLVED (duration 00:01:15).

alex: hm looks like PD auto-resolved while we were investigating — could be noise from a backend flapping or short autoscale reach.

sam: checked autoscaler events: one scale-up finished at 1749994328, there was a brief surge of connection resets from backend-instance-3.

lee: pinging infra-team about backend-instance-3 health checks and recent deploys.

lee: infra-ops: saw a transient kernel OOM on backend-instance-3 ~1749994310 -> container restarted, health checks failed briefly, LB returned 503s. Host patched with mitigations, but host is now stable.

alex: thanks. Customer impact assessment: potential limited impact to single merchant (the DM above) and synth alerts for us-east-1 only. No broad customer outage. Recommend post-incident note to owners of merchant DM and flag for follow-up if repeats.

sam: agree. short-term mitigation: drain backend-instance-3 from LB, cordon for deeper health check, add temporary route failover if needed.

alex: executing drain now:
```
kubectl -n infra cordon backend-instance-3 && kubectl -n infra drain backend-instance-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=120s
```

alex: drained and nodes are rebalancing — error-rate back to baseline on panels.

incident-bot: Note: PD incident PD7890 resolved automatically; no active pages remain.

lee: i'll follow up with infra to schedule a post-mortem on the host OOM and check kernel tunables. tagging infra-owner @infra-ops.

alex: handoff: i'm going offline in 10m, leaving follow-up to lee. If anything flares up reopen PD and ping @alex. :wave:

lee: ack. i'll open a follow-up ticket and DM the merchant proactively.

sam: adding a short runbook note: if autoscaler completes within spike window and host OOMs, prioritize draining host rather than scale back. i'll update runbook after postmortem.

alex: closing thread from primary on-call — marking as resolved, no further action required immediately.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD7890 closed by system (auto-resolve).

incident-bot: summary: transient backend host OOM caused a brief 503 spike in us-east-1, PD auto-resolved, manual drain + host reboot mitigated. Customer impact: isolated, under investigation.

lee: noted for follow-up. :thumbsup:
